description: Customer-facing read-only status lookup for a submitted order.

public_catalog.function: Lets a customer check whether an order is accepted, ready, completed, cancelled, or rejected.
public_catalog.data_access_summary: Order id, public order status, estimated ready time, fulfillment type, and payment method. No customer contact data, customer name, operator notes, or full event log.
public_catalog.operator_status: available in the pilot-node public order-status route when enabled
